company_research.summary: Medavie is a large Canadian not-for-profit health organization with over 10,000 employees, operating primarily in health insurance (Medavie Blue Cross) and emergency medical services. The 'Student - Automation' role is a learning-focused position involving API testing (Postman), SQL, and Git/GitLab within a software delivery framework. Employee sentiment is generally positive, with a 3.7–3.8 rating on Glassdoor and high marks for work-life balance (4.1/5), though some reviews mention steep learning curves and high turnover in remote roles.
